content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've experienced this issue twice now, where I'm unable to open a file and get stuck on a specific screen after closing the [product_name] software. Has anyone else encountered this? Additional details: - I'm using several user-defined functions. - I've hit the limit for function block names. - I've reached the maximum layout memory allowed. Thank you for any assistance!
Please upload your project file or archive it as a zip and share it here.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing issues with project file corruption when using [product_name], especially after exceeding system limitations and utilizing many user-defined functions. After closing the application, files sometimes cannot be reopened, resulting in workflow problems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable file management and recovery options to avoid data corruption when system limits are reached, ensuring that saved projects can always be reopened smoothly.
